description: Concentric radial bars showing users by device, each on its own track.
overview: A `RadialBarChart` with one bar per record in `chartData` (a `device` and a `users` count). Each bar is colored through a `Cell` that reads `chartConfig`, over a track in the control color. Pressing a bar shows a tooltip.
usage: Replace `chartData` with your records and add a matching entry per item to `chartConfig`, whose colors the `Cell` children read. The component takes no props.
